note_tweet.text:
Virginia is on the front lines of the fight to flip the House this November and bring down costs for working families. 

Yesterday I brought together Democrats from across the region to support Shannon Taylor (VA-01), Elaine Luria (VA-02), and Tom Perriello (VA-05) in their campaigns for Congress. Every Virginian from every corner of our Commonwealth has a stake in electing these three candidates, Beth Macy, and Joy Powers in November. 

Thank you to Lieutenant Governor Ghazala Hashmi, our candidates, and everyone who came out to support them!
